% 021 Phase 2 — per-solve cost vs panel count (ruling 9). Data:
% solver_scaling/<config>.csv (regenerated by benchmark/phase2_analysis.jl);
% fitted exponents in solver_scaling/fits.csv.
\documentclass[tikz]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.17}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{loglogaxis}[width=11cm, height=8cm,
    xlabel={panel count $N$}, ylabel={per-solve time [s]},
    legend pos=north west, legend style={font=\footnotesize},
    grid=both, minor grid style={gray!15}, major grid style={gray!35}]
\addplot[color=black, mark=square*, thick] table [col sep=comma, x=N, y=t_solve] {solver_scaling/backslash_ldiv.csv};
\addlegendentry{Backslash (ldiv)}
\addplot[color=red!70!black, mark=o, thick] table [col sep=comma, x=N, y=t_solve] {solver_scaling/krylov_gmres.csv};
\addlegendentry{GMRES}
\addplot[color=orange!80!black, mark=triangle*, thick] table [col sep=comma, x=N, y=t_solve] {solver_scaling/krylov_jacobi.csv};
\addlegendentry{GMRES+Jacobi}
\addplot[color=blue!70!black, mark=diamond*, thick] table [col sep=comma, x=N, y=t_solve] {solver_scaling/krylov_ilu.csv};
\addlegendentry{GMRES+ILU}
\addplot[color=green!50!black, mark=*, thick] table [col sep=comma, x=N, y=t_solve] {solver_scaling/fgs.csv};
\addlegendentry{FGS}
\addplot[color=violet, mark=pentagon*, thick] table [col sep=comma, x=N, y=t_solve] {solver_scaling/fgmres_fgs.csv};
\addlegendentry{FGMRES+FGS}
\end{loglogaxis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
